# Qt license notices

`qt/` contains the unmodified `LICENSES/` directory from QtBase v6.8.3,
commit `c07c2d5a527a644d36e7853d55132ae38921682f`, downloaded from
https://github.com/qt/qtbase/tree/v6.8.3/LICENSES .

The directory also includes QtDeclarative v6.8.3 license files from commit
`2ec235a2235a119887683e55787b93f99dc5f12f`, obtained from
https://github.com/qt/qtdeclarative/tree/v6.8.3/LICENSES . Identically named
SPDX license texts are shared between the two modules.

The deployment script copies these notices and the SDK's SPDX software
bill of materials into the local Windows package. See `docs/Dependencies.md`
for source locations and distribution status.
